name: Shad Ahm
title: Product Owner | Technical Product Leader | Enterprise Software
summary: Strategic Product Owner and Technical Leader with {{yearsOfExperience}} of hands-on software engineering experience. Own and refine a high-volume backlog of user stories, acceptance criteria, release notes, and product communication, improving delivery clarity and reducing ambiguity during planning, implementation, and release preparation.

Facilitate onboarding and knowledge sharing for new contributors, helping preserve product context, engineering workflow understanding, and continuity in a changing team environment.
Translate complex HVDC workflows into clear product requirements, integrating advanced engineering tools like PSCAD and data science optimization workflows into usable, scalable features.
